requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Whether the participant was under 18 when the offense happened
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Whether the participant was under 18 when the offense happened
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the participant's age at the offense is a case fact the platform does not hold
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: whether you were under 18 when the offense happened - this route exists only if you were

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court location where the conviction was effected, needed only on the petition branch
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court location where the conviction was effected, needed only on the petition branch
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the conviction location is a case fact, and on the petition branch it fixes the court whose accepted filings a lawyer would need to determine
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the Superior Court location where the conviction was effected - needed only on the petition branch, and the clerk's office there can confirm it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date the offense happened, confirmed against the case look-up
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date the offense happened, confirmed against the case look-up
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the offense date decides which branch applies and lives on the participant's own record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date the offense happened, confirmed against the Connecticut Judicial Branch online case look-up - this answer selects the branch, and nothing selects it for you

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Other charges on the same information, and whether any could not be erased
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Other charges on the same information, and whether any could not be erased
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the same-information limitation turns on charges the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the other charges on the same information, from the case look-up, and whether any of them was one that could not be erased - Sec. 54-142a(f)(3) turns on it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Statute sections of the conviction, copied from the record
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Statute sections of the conviction, copied from the record
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the sections decide the automatic branch's carve-outs and live on the record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the statute sections you were convicted under, copied from your record - the automatic branch does not reach a motor vehicle offense, a title 14 violation or a Sec. 51-164r violation
